description: Returns the authorization instructions for sending a previously quoted fax. THIS ACTION COSTS MONEY AND CANNOT BE UNDONE: paying the returned link transmits a real document to a real fax machine. This tool itself does not charge you — it returns the price and a payment link, and the fax is only sent once you deliberately pay that link. Confirm the cost is acceptable before paying.
name: send_fax
title: Send a fax (costs money)
